verification.visualReview: Direct source, desktop, mobile and A4 raster inspection; independent sampled eyes confirmed final equation wrapping, normal font, grid directions and source sum. verification.difficultyLimit: Source level preserves each task. Easier adds a useful scaffold. Harder reconstructs a height, derives total from floor and added cubes, or converts edge length to unit face area before the source task. No empirical student difficulty calibration claimed.
